items.title: ZUS refused 800+ for the healthy siblings. The courts disagreed
items.excerpt: Since 1 February 2026 foreign parents must prove paid employment. Three administrative court rulings show where ZUS goes too far and how to appeal.

items.title: PLN 300 per child from ZUS. Can a foreigner claim it?
items.excerpt: Your residence title decides, not your citizenship. Since 1 July 2026 a legal-work condition applies, and ZUS accepts applications only until 30 November.

items.title: Advocate, legal counsel or lawyer? Who to choose for your residence card case
items.excerpt: Before the voivode anyone can act as your representative; before the court only an advocate or a legal counsel. What really differs and who to pick for a residence card or work permit.
